import os
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Disable progress bars and warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
pd.set_option("future.no_silent_downcasting", False)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_data = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_data = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_data = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Class order matching sample submission
class_order = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Encode target variables to integers for LightGBM
train_data["label_num"] = train_data["author"].map(
    {c: i for i, c in enumerate(class_order)}
)
y_train_num = train_data["label_num"].values.astype(int)
X_train_texts = train_data["text"].fillna("").tolist()

test_data["label_num"] = (
    test_data["author"].map({c: i for i, c in enumerate(class_order)}).fillna(-1)
)
# Note: test_data has 'id', 'text' but we infer test author later.
# We just need text for vectorization here.
y_test_texts = test_data["text"].fillna("").tolist()

# Prepare Feature Matrix
# Using word + bigram as per Memory/Standard NLP practice for this task
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w+\b", ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_features=50000
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(y_test_texts)

# Hold-out validation split for metric evaluation (80/20)
n_rows = len(train_data)
split_idx = int(n_rows * 0.8)
idx_end_train = split_idx

X_val = X_train_vec[split_idx:]
y_val = y_train_num[split_idx:]
X_train_full = X_train_vec[:split_idx]
y_train_full = y_train_num[:split_idx]

# Parameters for LightGBM
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 3,
    "metric": "binary",  # LightGBM supports multiclass via 'multiclass' objective, metric is logloss
    "verbosity": -1,  # Silent mode
    "seed": 42,
    "boosting_type": "dart",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "subsampling_freq": 0.8,
    "lambda_l1": 1,
    "lambda_l2": 1,
}
params["metric"] = (
    "auc"  # LightGBM uses auc for ranking internally but for regression/classification tasks logloss is standard.
)

train_set = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full, label=y_train_full, free_raw_data=False)
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_set,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    callbacks=[],  # Explicitly empty to suppress callbacks/logs
)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_proba = model.predict(X_val, raw_score=False)
# Ensure probability matrix shape matches number of classes (3)
# model.predict returns (n_samples, n_classes) for multiclass?
# For LightGBM, predict returns shape (n_samples, n_classes) if raw_score=False.
if y_val_proba.shape != (len(X_val), 3):
    raise ValueError(f"Predictions shape mismatch: {y_val_proba.shape}")

# Compute Log Loss manually to satisfy requirements
# Note: sklearn log_loss handles multiclass if y_true is int labels
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_proba, average="weighted")
print(f"Validation Log-Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

# Retrain on Full Training Data
model = lgb.train(params, train_set, num_boost_round=1000)
final_proba = model.predict(X_test_vec, raw_score=False)

# Create Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_data["id"],
        "EAP": final_proba[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_proba[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_proba[:, 2],
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
